title: Optimize SiH5- minimum at MP2/6-31G(d,p)
action: Build the SiH5- molecular system and perform a geometry optimization at the MP2/6-31G(d,p) level to locate a minimum-energy structure.
description: Geometry optimization yields the minimum-energy structure and its total energy, used to compute the barrier.

title: Transition state search and frequency verification for SiH5-
action: Locate the transition state (TS) for Berry pseudorotation of SiH5- at the MP2/6-31G(d,p) level. Confirm the TS character by a vibrational frequency calculation showing exactly one imaginary frequency. Record the TS energy.
description: The TS energy is required to compute the barrier.

title: Compute pseudorotation barrier
action: Calculate the activation barrier as ΔE = E(TS) – E(min) using the energies from the previous steps, convert to kcal/mol, and write the result to /app/outputs/barrier_kcal_mol.txt.
description: The pseudorotation energy barrier (ΔE) in kcal/mol, computed as the difference between the MP2/6-31G(d,p) energies of the transition state and the minimum.
output_schema: A single ASCII floating-point number, e.g., '2.0'.
